title: Laughed at in a junk car, back in a supercar
description: A rich couple bicker while washing their supercar and laugh when Nate, in a rusty junk car, says he can buy one. He trades on fomo from that junk car night after night, the wins stack up, and three years later he rolls up in his own supercar. The car-detailing business becomes fomo trading; the live-action tag becomes the fomo end line.
text:
SCENE 1 — EXT. VILLA DRIVEWAY — DAY
A rich couple wash their mud-streaked red supercar outside a villa with a pool; she shoves his sponge away from the bonnet.
WOMAN: You're scratching it!
HUSBAND: Then you do it!
Nate, cap backwards, watches deadpan from the wheel of a rusty old sedan, then leans out of the window.
NATE: I can buy that.
HUSBAND: You?
HUSBAND: In that junk car?
NATE: Just watch.
The husband folds his arms, smug.
HUSBAND: Let him try.
SCENE 2 — MONTAGE — NATE'S JUNK CAR — NIGHTS
Nate in the driver's seat of his junk car at night, his phone lighting his face.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — on Nate's phone, a red day; his thumb hovers over Sell
Nate pulls his thumb back and holds; he drops his head onto the steering wheel.
Another night: rain on the cracked windscreen, Nate rubbing his eyes, still on the charts.
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, a small win: the position reads +$12
A tiny fist pump; the dashboard clock glows 3 a.m.
Another late night: Nate eating cold fries, eyes on the chart; the position reads +$95.
SCENE 3 — EXT. VILLA DRIVEWAY — DAY
Nate rolls up beside the couple in the junk car and holds his phone out of the window; they lean in.
HUSBAND: Wait.
HUSBAND: What?!
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — on Nate's phone, the position reads +$350
Nate looks at his phone; his eyes pop and a grin spreads.
NATE: 350?
The woman crouches by the supercar, phone to her ear, calling her friends.
WOMAN: Girls, you need this app!
★ fomo screen: Home — on the woman's phone as she holds it up
SCENE 4 — MONTAGE — THE RISE
Nate trades from the junk car, grinning; the position reads +$2,400.
Nate at a new desk in a small apartment; the balance reads $9,800.
Another late night, Nate still at it; the balance reads $26,000.
Nate drops the junk car's keys into a scrapyard worker's hand and walks off grinning.
Nate at a big desk over a city view; the balance reads $71,000; he looks up to camera and smiles.
SCENE 5 — INT. SUPERCAR SHOWROOM — DAY — THREE YEARS LATER
A white flash onto the glossy nose of a purple supercar.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $640,000
Nate signs for the purple supercar, calm and satisfied.
Nate drives the purple supercar up a palm-lined road toward the villa.
SCENE 6 — EXT. VILLA DRIVEWAY — DAY
The husband, in shirtsleeves, washes the red car himself with a yellow sponge, the woman behind him; Nate pulls up beside them in the purple supercar.
HUSBAND: How'd you afford that?
NATE: You were busy arguing.
NATE: I was busy getting paid.
HUSBAND: Hahaha.
Whip to an extreme close-up of the husband as it lands.
HUSBAND: WHAT?!
Nate turns to camera from the driver's seat with a small smirk.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Nate's phone, the balance reads $640,000
NATE: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.

cast.description: Teen, slim; big brown eyes, curly dark hair; navy cap worn backwards, thin silver chain, plain white tee, dark joggers. Three years later: same cap and chain, a black knit tee, sharper and calmer.
40s, broad and burly; dark side-parted hair; navy suit and tie in the opening, rolled-up cream shirtsleeves at the end. Sneering, smug face.
30s, slim; long wavy brown hair; white crop top, black shorts. Loud, dramatic expressions.
